MRT.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.
AI tools for research are named only as network content, not a public sector system in service.
AI tools for research are named with no model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted.
Teacher training in digital tools is not civil-servant training.
No public digital-skills programme or measured share.
The university partnership supports doctoral work generally; no digital policy research is stated.

facts.fact: Authorities inaugurated the Mauritanian Education and Scientific Research Network in July 2026, connecting universities, research centres and higher-education institutions with secure high-speed internet and eduroam, according to Agence Ecofin.
